## Overview

Welcome to **Modern AI: Architectural Foundations, Mathematical Rigor & End-to-End Systems** (2026–2027).

This course covers modern AI architectures, mathematical fundamentals, training and optimization techniques, experiment infrastructure, and capstone applied projects.
